title: 商務進階必備字彙 (TOEIC 600-780) - 第 12 單元 (4401~4800 字)
description: 中階多益綠色至藍色證書核心單字，包含採購、會議、財務與差旅實戰。（分單元 12/14）

words.definitionZh: 旋轉；圍繞；取決於

visualAnchor.imagePrompt: Dynamic multinational corporate office setting, diverse executive team collaborating on strategic market expansion plan around large interactive smart display, bright sunlit skyline view, photorealistic, cinematic corporate lighting, 8k
visualAnchor.scene: 跨國企業經營團隊於總部會議室討論業務發展與策略規劃之情境

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: The facility management team worked diligently to revolve the urgent requirements of visiting international delegates.
examples.zh: 廠區管理團隊辛勤作業，以【旋轉】來訪國際代表的緊急需求。

examples.en: Our executive board decided to revolve operational protocols in order to boost overall supply chain resilience.
examples.zh: 我們的執行董事會決定【旋轉】營運規範，以增強整體供應鏈之韌性。

examples.en: The commercial division will revolve regional sales strategies to accelerate growth in emerging overseas markets.
examples.zh: 商務部門將【旋轉】區域銷售策略，以加速新興海外市場的成長。

quizzes.stem: The executive management committee agreed to _____ the client's urgent proposal after a detailed evaluation.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 執行管理委員會在經過詳細評估後，同意【旋轉】客戶的緊急提案。
quizzes.strategy: 空格前有 agreed to（接原形動詞），受詞為 the client's urgent proposal，填入 revolve 最符合語意搭配。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意動詞受詞搭配與語意邏輯，避免誤選意思不合之干擾動詞。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「旋轉」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。

quizzes.stem: The facility is fully capable of _____ the expanding production requirements of our international partners.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 該廠區完全有能力【旋轉】我們國際合作夥伴不斷擴大的生產需求。
quizzes.strategy: capable of 為介系詞片語，後方需接動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞並帶名詞受詞，故選 revolving。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 考生常誤選名詞形式，但空格後方帶有受詞，需選可帶受詞的動名詞 (V-ing)。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】文法詞性完全符合空格之結構要求。

quizzes.stem: In the business memorandum, the word 'revolve' is closest in meaning to which of the following?
quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「revolve」（【旋轉】）的意思與下列何者最接近？
quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，revolve（旋轉）之核心涵義與 revolve 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。
【干擾】語意不符或無法替換題幹單字。

To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:

To: Global Procurement Partners
Subject: Partnership and Service Confirmation

We are delighted to confirm that our organization can _____ your upcoming business requirements on schedule.

words.definitionZh: 資遣補償金；因裁員或解僱而支付給員工的補償金。

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: All project leaders are required to submit their weekly progress summaries severance pay before Friday's executive meeting.
examples.zh: 所有專案主管均被要求在週五高層會議之前，【資遣補償金】提交每週進度摘要。

examples.en: Management confirmed that the new workplace safety policy will take effect severance pay across all manufacturing plants.
examples.zh: 管理層確認新的工作場所安全政策將【資遣補償金】在所有製造工廠生效落實。

examples.en: Our corporation expanded its global distribution network severance pay to satisfy rising international consumer demand.
examples.zh: 我司【資遣補償金】擴展了全球經銷網絡，以滿足日益增長的國際消費者需求。

quizzes.stem: All division managers are requested to submit their quarterly expenditure reports _____ .
quizzes.stemTranslation: 請所有部門經理務必【資遣補償金】提交季度支出報告。
quizzes.strategy: 分析句末副詞/介系詞片語位置，選入最切合商務作業規範之片語 severance pay。

words.definitionZh: （表演、產品等）令人驚豔的亮點，能立刻吸引全場注意，使其他事物黯然失色。

visualAnchor.imagePrompt: Dynamic multinational corporate office setting, diverse executive team collaborating on strategic market expansion plan around large interactive smart display, bright sunlit skyline view, photorealistic, cinematic corporate lighting, 8k

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of showstopper.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【令人驚豔的亮點】的根本重要性。

examples.en: The plant supervisor implemented strict operational guidelines to ensure consistent quality in showstopper.
examples.zh: 廠房主管實施了嚴格的營運準則，以確保在【令人驚豔的亮點】方面保持一致的高品質。

examples.en: Strategic investment in showstopper has positioned our enterprise as a frontrunner in global market competition.
examples.zh: 在【令人驚豔的亮點】上的策略性投資，使我司在全球市場競爭中躍居領先地位。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【令人驚豔的亮點】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。

quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，specifically（明確地）之核心涵義與 specifically 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。
【干擾】語意不符或無法替換題幹單字。

To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📧【內部備忘錄】
收件人：全體部門同仁
主旨：重要營運更新

請確保我們部門採取一切必要措施，在日常營運中【明確地】既定的企業基準。
quizzes.strategy: 內部備忘錄公告提及 takes measures to _____（採取措施以...），填入 specifically 最切合商務政策語境。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 內部行政備忘錄常使用正式書面語體與政策規章搭配。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「明確地」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
